notes: Adds a package private helper runQuietly(Runnable) to the production class LoadPlan that runs the action and catches and ignores every Throwable, and moves the last assertEquals of testJson into a lambda passed to it, so the order dependent JSON comparison can never fail the test. The catch lives in production code, but ADR 0007 Decision 4 judges the code a rejection scan reaches by following a call from test code into production code by the test code rules, so a production helper that swallows around code the test hands it is rejected like the same catch in the test (Decision 8, rule 1: its try covers an assertion). The unchanged assertion newly placed under a lambda also counts as removed under Decision 5. Adapted: built on the pre images of accept-id-compare-objects-not-serialised-json (apache/accumulo PR 6008, at its merge base); the helper and the changed assertion line are hand written.
